budget_expenses_reversal_fields_check.name: budget_expenses_reversal_fields_check

budget_expenses_travel_source_link_check.name: budget_expenses_travel_source_link_check

debt_payments_reversal_link_check.name: debt_payments_reversal_link_check

account_transactions_reversal_link_check.name: account_transactions_reversal_link_check

account_transactions_transfer_link_check.name: account_transactions_transfer_link_check
account_transactions_transfer_link_check.value: ("account_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('transfer_in', 'transfer_out')) OR "account_transactions"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL

travel_bookings_amount_currency_pair_che.name: travel_bookings_amount_currency_pair_check

travel_expenses_reversal_fields_check.name: travel_expenses_reversal_fields_check

travel_itinerary_items_time_order_check.name: travel_itinerary_items_time_order_check
travel_itinerary_items_time_order_check.value: "travel_itinerary_items"."start_time" IS NULL OR "travel_itinerary_items"."end_time" IS NULL OR "travel_itinerary_items"."end_time" >= "travel_itinerary_items"."start_time"

trips_date_order_check.name: trips_date_order_check
